nodes.title: LIGHTNING EDITION V2.1
widgets_values:
# RUNPOD BUNDLE

Use `MODEL_PROFILE=lightning-longvideo`. This production bundle uses the connected Q8 High/Low route; the source ZIP's disconnected FP8 alternates are intentionally omitted. The selected Enhanced V2 checkpoint already includes Lightning. All optional LoRAs below are downloaded but intentionally OFF; do not stack another Lightning LoRA unless you deliberately want to retune motion.


# NSFW LIGHTNING EDITION MODELS

## Civitai Model
[🔗 Civitai Model](https://civitai.com/models/2053259?modelVersionId=2477539)

## Text Encoders
- **FP8**: [🔗 umt5_xxl_fp8 text_encoder](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors)
- **FP16**: [🔗 umt5_xxl_fp16 text_encoder](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors)

## VAE
[🔗 wan_2.1_vae](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors?download=true)


# Motion Settings

## Motion Amplitude
**Description:** Motion intensity multiplier  
**Default / Recommended:** 1.0 = normal, 1.15 = recommended  
**Range:** 1.0 – 2.0

## Motion Frames
**Description:** Number of trailing frames from `previous_video` used as motion reference  
**Default:** 5

# Video Resolution Settings

## FindPerfectResolution
**Description:** Adjusts the correct aspect ratio of the image for the video


🎨 
**COLOR STRENGTH**

Controls color drift correction strength.

0.0 → no color issues  
0.01 – 0.05 → slight drift  
0.1 – 0.15 → strong shift  
0.2 – 0.3 → severe drift

Be careful, video upscaling can be very time-consuming depending on the length, and even more so with interpolation. It can also cause your PC to lag. Here, the value is set to 0.5 on a 4x upscaler, so it will be a 2x upscale. For example: a 512 video will be upscaled to 1024.

nodes.title: TUTO
widgets_values:
# Adding New Video Sections

You can add new sections very easily.  

1. Copy the **second section (10-second video)**, including:  
   - the **subgraph** and **Get nodes**  
   - the **LoRA High node**  
   - the **LoRA Low node**  
   - the **Seed nodes**

2. Paste it **next to section 2**.

3. Connect the **image output of section 2** to the **image input 1** of the new section.

> Tip: Make sure all node connections are intact to avoid missing input errors.

> ⚠️ **Important Quality Warning**  
> The longer the video is extended, the more the overall quality may gradually degrade over time.  
> This is expected behavior when chaining multiple video generations.

---

# Usage Tips (Longer Videos)

If you want to create videos longer than 5 seconds:

First, generate the first video.

If you don’t like the result, simply change the seed and generate again.

If you like the video, enable the second video.  
The seed remains the same.  
The first video will not be generated again.  
Only the second video will be generated.

Repeat the same process for the following videos.

### Additional Tip
If the workflow appears empty or no nodes are visible (this can happen when opening subgraphs):  
Click **Fit View** in the Canvas menu.  
If the Canvas is not visible, enable it here:  
`Settings → Canvas → Lite Graph → Show Graph Canvas`
